semiconductor_relevance: High — the Czech Pavilion represents a collective of Czech companies and institutions with significant contributions to the semiconductor value chain.
summary: The Czech Pavilion showcases over 70 years of semiconductor expertise, featuring Czech companies, universities, and R&D institutions that develop advanced technologies across the semiconductor value chain. This includes areas such as chip design, power electronics, and advanced microscopy, positioning Czechia as a key player in the global semiconductor ecosystem.
capabilities: Chip design expertise in RISC-V and power electronics
Manufacturing of semiconductor wafers and chips

regional_presence.Czech Republic: Czechia is a global leader in electron microscopy and semiconductor manufacturing, producing over 3 million wafers and 3 billion chips annually.
